subject.title: Discord plugin: channels added to channels.discord.guilds.*.channels.* post-startup are never subscribed (requires full gateway restart)

question: Is source-level evidence of the generic `channels.discord` channel-restart path sufficient to close this report, or should maintainers require a live/focused Discord add-channel repro before choosing the repair boundary?
rationale: The source has an intended restart path, but the newer v2026.6.1 report contradicts the earlier source-only close and the current review cannot prove the live Discord subscription behavior without credentials and a running gateway.

options.title: Require live reload proof
options.body: Keep this open until a maintainer or live Discord repro identifies whether the miss is in config watching, reload planning, channel restart, provider startup, or gateway event handling.

options.title: Close as source-implemented
options.body: Accept the generic reload-to-channel-restart source path as sufficient despite the newer production report and close this as already implemented.

recommendation.title: Require live reload proof
recommendation.body: Keep this open until a maintainer or live Discord repro identifies whether the miss is in config watching, reload planning, channel restart, provider startup, or gateway event handling.
